title: Desk Stretches
intro: A few gentle ideas for a short break. Go slowly, breathe, and skip anything that does not feel right.

cards.back: Lift both shoulders toward your ears, roll them back and down, and repeat a few times at an easy pace.
Rest your eyes on something across the room or out of a window for a slow count of twenty.
Look over one shoulder as far as is comfortable, pause, then look over the other. Keep it small and slow.
Sit tall, clasp your hands behind you if that is easy, and let your chest open for a few breaths.
Let your arms hang and loosen your wrists and fingers for a few seconds.
Stand up, raise your arms overhead and stretch up, then let them float back down.
Feel your feet on the floor, lengthen your spine, then let your jaw and shoulders relax.
Walk to the window or fetch a glass of water, taking your time on the way back.
